title: Pico Pipette demo
description: A scripted demonstration of Pico Pipette, run with: node demo/demo.mjs <file>.yaml

title.description: What the demo is called (shown in the terminal when it runs).

url.description: The Pipette page to open. Defaults to the live site. A web address given on the command line overrides it.

pace.description: Scales every pause, pointer glide and typing delay: 1.5 is slower, 0.8 quicker. DEMO_PACE overrides it.

viewport.description: Size of the page in pixels (default 1280 x 900).

steps.description: What happens, in order. Each step has exactly one action.

nothing.description: Takes no value: write the action followed by a colon.

caption.description: Show a caption at the bottom of the page. An empty string hides it.

pause.description: Wait this many seconds (scaled by pace).

click.description: Move the pointer to a button and click it. Name a button, or give a CSS selector.

selector.description: A CSS selector for what to click.

wait.description: Wait until the Pico is connected, the program has finished or stopped, or nothing is in progress.

type.description: Replace the program in the editor, typing it in.

rename.description: Type a new name for the tab showing into the file name box (e.g. after click: new-tab).

tab.description: Click the tab of an open file, by its name (e.g. helpers.py). To start a new tab, use click: new-tab.

edit.description: Point at some text in the editor, select it and type over it.

in.description: Which occurrence: the first `find` inside the first occurrence of this text.

run.description: Click Run. Waits until the program finishes, unless given { wait: false }.

wait.description: Wait for the program to finish (default true).

stop.description: Click Stop, and wait until the program has stopped.

repl.description: Type into the REPL and press Enter. Several lines are entered as one block.

input.description: Type a line to the running program's input() and press Enter.

install.description: Install a package: a micropython-lib name, github:org/repo, or a URL.

save-main.description: Click Save as main.py and wait until it's saved.

scroll.description: Scroll the page smoothly to the top, the bottom, or a part of the page.
